sampling_unit: one deterministic representative per connected source family and language

policy.selection_rule: qualifying model with greatest minimum accepted fraction over required languages; ties use candidate order

candidate_initialization: each training candidate starts from the pinned base; later candidates are optional if an earlier candidate qualifies
baseline: training-only class-frequency distribution with add-one smoothing; descriptive, not deployable
final_test: evaluate the locked selected model and thresholds once; never use results to select another candidate
failure_rule: no qualifying candidate means no automatic deployment; retain explicit review outcomes and report the failed gate
limitations: English and first Modern Standard Arabic variant only
no ordinal urgency or boolean gold tasks
no guarantee for future distribution shift
